Village
Bamhani, Thana Doundi, District Balod (Chhattisgarh) (Wrongly Mentioned  Ravishankar Sahu In The Impugned Order), District : Balod, Chhattisgarh
---- Applicant  Versus   The State Of Chhattisgarh Through- Police Station
Doundi, District : Balod,
Chhattisgarh
---- Respondent For Applicant : Shri Hemant Agrawal, Advocate For State : Shri G.P.Kurrey, Panel Lawyer Hon'ble Shri Justice Sachin Singh Rajput Order On Board 20/02/2023 1.

The applicant has been arrested in connection with Crime No.96/2022 registered at Police Station - Doundi, District - Balod (C.G.) for alleged commission of offences under Section 363, 366, 376 (2)
(n) of IPC and Section 4, 5 (1) / 6 of POCSO Act.
2. Case of prosecution, in brief, is that the applicant, on the pretext of marriage, kidnapped the minor girl and committed rape on her.
3. Learned counsel for the applicant submits that the applicant has been falsely implicated.
It is submitted that the prosecutrix has been examined and she has not supported the case of the prosecution.
It is next submitted that the applicant is in jail since 05/07/2022 and trial is likely to take some time.
Therefore, the applicant may be granted bail.
4. On the other hand, learned State counsel opposes the bail application and submits that looking to the allegations leveled, the application may be rejected.
5. On 05/01/2023, the prosecutrix and her mother appeared through V.C. from the concerned DLSA.
The prosecutrix did not object and her mother objected to grant of bail to the applicant.
6. I have heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the case diary.

sentences.text: 7. Looking to the facts and circumstances of the case, statement of the prosecutrix and detention period, without commenting anything on merits, I am inclined to grant bail to the applicant.
8. Accordingly, the application is allowed.

It is directed that the applicant shall be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.25,000/- along with one surety for the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court on the condition that - a) He shall appear before the trial Court regularly on each and every date, unless exempted from appearance.
b) He shall not make any attempt to tamper with the prosecution witnesses.
c) He shall not meet any of the prosecution witnesses till conclusion of trial.
